metadata.datasource:
Film data: KODAK VISION2 100T Color Negative Film 5212/7212 technical data (H-1-5212t), digitized by direct PDF vector-stroke extraction (PoLUT has no spec for this sheet). Original data are property of Eastman Kodak. Processing: Built by the spektrafilm.exe fork from Kodak datasheet vision2-dated/5212-Vision2-100T-125px.pdf (digitized with PoLUT, GPL-3.0), processed with Andrea Volpato's published profile factory (March 2026, GPL-3.0) re-implemented in this repo. hanatos2025 adaptation parameters and the non-spectral profile structure are inherited from kodak_vision3_200t (spektrafilm profile by Andrea Volpato, CC BY-SA 4.0). This is a derivative work, not an upstream profile. Density curves then corrected with Andrea Volpato's published grey-ramp algorithm (profiles_factory/correct.py, March 2026) run through this app's pipeline on kodak_2383, data_trustability=0.3. Status M densitometer responses from the spektrafilm repository.
    RMS granularity [6.2, 8.4, 23.6] (R, G, B) MEASURED: all three channels read off the sheet's Diffuse rms Granularity chart at absolute density 1.0 (Kodak Vision2 100T 5212.pdf p3, rms_curve_read.py), stored as read (NAT 2026-09-24); a curve read is good to about 7%. Embedded 2026-09-24. Supersedes the earlier value [7.3, 8.4, 16.3].
